items.stem: A sketch shows blue entities that move when dragged. What does this indicate?

options.rationale: Correct: blue, draggable geometry means the sketch lacks relations/dimensions to fully define it.
A fully defined sketch is typically black and does not drag.
Over-defined sketches report conflicts, usually in a different colour.

options.text: The part has failed to rebuild
options.rationale: Rebuild failures are reported separately, not by blue sketch colour.

items.stem: Which mate makes two cylindrical faces share the same axis?

options.rationale: Correct: a concentric mate aligns cylindrical faces to a common axis.
Coincident aligns points/faces to be touching/coplanar, not axis-sharing.
Parallel keeps entities parallel but not coaxial.
Distance sets an offset, not a shared axis.

items.stem: Which TWO belong in a production drawing of a part?

options.rationale: Correct: dimensions/tolerances define the part for manufacture.
